senses.gloss: (prob. to be read: פִּלְפֵּל, v. פַּלְפֵּל II) to roll. Tanḥ. ed. Bub. Ḥuck. 3 ראו עיניה מְפַלְבְּלוֹת they saw the eyes of the cow roll (squint to look at the yoke, v. פָּזַל). Ib. כשהן באין … מפלבלות עיניה (prob. to be read: היתה מְפַלְבֶּלֶת) when they came to put a yoke on her, she rolled her eyes.
